Does Planning Healthier Meals Feel Difficult?

You are not alone. Many Nigerians want to eat in a more balanced way, but everyday life makes it hard to stay organized.

  • Not knowing what to eat each day.
  • Finding it difficult to plan meals around familiar Nigerian dishes.
  • Being unsure about appropriate food portions.
  • Struggling to maintain consistent eating habits.
  • Spending too much time deciding what to cook.

A structured meal plan can take away the daily guesswork and make meal planning more organized and manageable. It is not about shame or pressure, and not everyone needs to lose weight. It is about having a clear plan you can follow at your own pace.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the 30-Day Nigerian Weight-Loss Meal Plan?

It is an ebook by Dr. Jane Adeyemi that helps you organize meals over 30 days using familiar Nigerian foods, with guidance on portion control and healthier eating habits.

Is this ebook suitable for Nigerians?

Yes. It is written around Nigerian foods, lifestyle and everyday meal choices.

No. The idea is to plan balanced meals with foods you already know, paying attention to variety and portions.
